description: Find drawings by drawing number or name fragment across the user's projects (or within one project) and return their ids, project, revision_count and web_url. Use this when the user names a drawing rather than an id. Walks at most 20 projects and says so if truncated.

project_id.description: Limit the search to one project.

query.description: Drawing number or part of the name, e.g. "1001-300".

name: xenmark_find_drawing
